block.guhs.fossiel_broedmachine.lore: Put a fossil and cheese nibbles in: under the glass bell it hatches an egg. After a whole day an ancient guh crawls out!
block.guhs.fossiel_broedmachine.lore.kra: %s vadskracht while it hatches, %s cheese nibbles per egg
gui.guhs.fossiel.al_een: There is already a fossil under the bell, vadsje. One egg at a time!
gui.guhs.fossiel.uitgekomen: Crack! A baby %s crawls out of the ancient egg. It squeaks at you right away: VAHOEG!
gui.guhs.fossiel.status.leeg: The bell is empty. Put a fossil in (and 16 cheese nibbles).
gui.guhs.fossiel.status.broedt: The egg of a %s is hatching: %s%%
gui.guhs.fossiel.status.broedt_slaapt: The egg of a %s is paused at %s%%: no vadskracht!
gui.guhs.fossiel.status.knabbels: A fossil of a %s. Still needs cheese nibbles: %s of %s.
gui.guhs.fossiel.status.kracht: A fossil of a %s, ready to hatch. Now %s vadskracht!
gui.guhs.fossiel.mammoet_wol: %s shakes its coat: wool for you!
gui.guhs.fossiel.stokstaartje_ziet: %s stands on its hind paws and points: a %s, %s, %s blocks away!
item.guhs.fossiel_mammoet.lore: A bit of tusk in stone. Deep under the wool there once lay a whole woolly guh, njeg.
item.guhs.fossiel_tguh.lore: A little skull with very many teeth. Luckily it only eats cheese nibbles.
item.guhs.fossiel_pteroguh.lore: A wing bone with a crest. This guh flew around before cheese even existed!
item.guhs.fossiel_stokstaartje.lore: A tiny skeleton that still stands upright. It keeps watch, even as a fossil.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.mammoetguh: Rarity: Only from the Fossil Hatchery
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.mammoetguh: A woolly brown ancient guh with a little trunk and two tusks. Strong as a vads bear: in a guh house it does its chores twice as fast. Cuddle it and it shakes a bit of wool out of its coat. Hatches from a Mammoth Guh Fossil, njeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.tguh: Rarity: Only from the Fossil Hatchery
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.tguh: A green ancient guh with teeny tiny arms and a thick tail. The best watcher there is: with the Watch chore it spots monsters coming from very far away and chases them off. Can't touch its own nose. Hatches from a T-Guh Fossil!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.pteroguh: Rarity: Only from the Fossil Hatchery
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.pteroguh: A teal ancient guh with little wings and a crest on its head. When it lives in a guh house it flies what the chores bring in to chests that stand much further away. Flap flap, vads! Hatches from a Pteroguh Fossil.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.stokstaartjeguh: Rarity: Only from the Fossil Hatchery
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.stokstaartjeguh: A sand-coloured ancient guh with dark patches around its eyes. When it stands still it stands up and keeps watch. When it spots a rare guh nearby it shows you the way. Hatches from an Ancient Meerkat Fossil!
